jobs.name: Signal Runner
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D arcade game spritesheet, Signal Runner renewal. Create ONE perfectly regular 4-column by 4-row sheet, 16 isolated sprites on true transparent alpha, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no background. Every cell contains exactly one centered sprite and ample clear padding, no sprite crossing cell boundaries. Each ROW is four successive frames of ONE consistent subject, identical scale/pivot/anatomy/materials across that row, subtle readable animation. Row 1: nimble white-and-electric-cyan courier robot with a cobalt visor, compact rounded body, short limbs, animated running/dashing with a short cyan energy scarf. Row 2: hostile crimson and magenta triangular signal-leech drone, three small claw legs and one bright eye, animated scuttling/charging. Row 3: a concentrated cyan radio-energy pulse projectile with a white core and swept electric arcs, pulsing four frames, SAME silhouette and center. Row 4: one chunky modular dark navy radio relay gate/partition block with cyan circuit inlays, four stages of signal-light pulsing. Style: polished hand-painted sci-fi game sprites, luminous hard surface accents, bold graphic silhouettes with clear dark outlines, crisp edges, restrained bloom, rich shaded detail that remains readable at 32px. Camera: top-down three-quarter arcade sprite view, fixed camera per row. Match high-quality modern indie arcade art, keep the robot/drone clearly distinct. No scenery or decorative extra objects. Precisely aligned 4x4 cells. Square sheet, transparent outside the sixteen sprites.
